description: Respond templates for carrier_slot runs, one per genre, and the run's template_map (column genre). Save each with dataworks_save_generation_template (kind respond, behaviour_key, check_rule_sets = each template's check_rule_sets (D72: the pilot rule set's new version, the pin of recipe.json; its version is filled at 17.3 from the save), check_phrases = plan.json phrase_list) so the template check (FR-017.16) runs at save. The templates hold no example value and none of the framing phrases: a model copies what its template shows (miDataworks memory 'measure wording before publishing pairs'). Placeholders: {slot} (the run's slot token), {placement}, {length_band}, {framing} from the plan row. Bodies are the ones the SSN dry run generated with (2026-11-01, `ran`): v4 for every genre, and for voice_transcript v4@3 (2026-11-26, FU-7a; before it v4@2, whose own first v4 lost nearly all of Qwen's voice rows to a word in the template). Superseded bodies and why are in `history`. A generator measured on other bodies has them under by_generator, with the ids it ran, why and the pilots' keep rates: Gemma's seen-genre v4@2 (FU-7a W4, 2026-11-27).

Length: {length_band} (short: under 280 characters; medium: 280 to 1,200 characters; long: over 1,200 characters).
Use varied names, places, companies and wording.

Nothing else in the template map changed; the rule-set pin is unchanged.

runs.note: 5 slot repeated, 1 slot missing; 53 of 54 kept rows all lower case outside the marker
